purpose: Teach: チェルシー/太宰/アンパン/紀伊国屋/バロック/リアリズム/ホビー/マイカー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがチェルシーのユニフォームを下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to get you a Chelsea uniform.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Opening is soft and clear. Smiling tone — taking pleasure in sharing good news. Slight lift at the end, inviting his reaction. Tender in the way an older sister shares something precious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと太宰治の絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a Dazai picture book together!
lines.style: Bright, quick energy. Words tumble out with genuine excitement. Slight breathlessness — eager to share. Leans forward. The guileless joy of a six-year-old who wants her to know he's been doing something special.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアンパンマンの映画に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to take you to see the Anpanman movie.
lines.style: Same gentle framework as before. Warm announcement delivered with knowing tenderness. Slight pause before the activity — letting it land. The tone of someone who loves watching him light up.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、紀伊国屋書店で絵本買ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I bought a picture book at Kinokuniya today!
lines.style: Bright, tumbling words. Quick pace. The pride of ownership and discovery mixed together. Wants her to see how grown-up he is for buying it himself. Small, genuine pride in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバロック音楽を聴かせて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to play Baroque music for you.
lines.style: Consistent warmth and gentle delivery. The same soft opening, same tender rhythm. A slight sense of amusement — she knows this might sound unexpected to a six-year-old, but she's delivering it with complete sincerity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとリアリズムの絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a picture book about realism!
lines.style: Same bright tumble as before. Quick, eager. Slightly more pride in the voice — he's sharing something conceptually bigger. The energy of a child who's been listened to, who knows grown-ups take his interests seriously.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホビーショップに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to take you to the hobby shop.
lines.style: The established warm rhythm continues. Opening is soft. Steady, assured delivery. The familiarity of a repeated pattern — she's enjoying this, the back-and-forth, sharing each small plan with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんのマイカーに乗ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got to ride in Dad's car!
lines.style: Bright, sharp peak at opening. Quick, proud delivery. The culmination of excitement — this is the biggest thing. Eyes wide. Small laugh threaded through. The pure delight of a child who's been included in something he feels matters.
